channel.title: Austin County News Online - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin County News Online (austincountynewsonline.com)

item.title: PAC Attack: How Big Money Is Hijacking Our District 85 Primary
item.description: In the HD 85 primary, third-party PACs have flooded mailboxes across rural Texas counties with glossy attack mailers, outspending the candidates themselves before the March 3 vote.

item.title: Texas Primary Ballot Propositions Explained: What Austin County Voters Should Know
item.description: Texas primary propositions hit ballots March 3, 2026 with 10 GOP and 13 Democratic advisory questions on taxes, healthcare, education, and immigration—vote yes/no to shape your party's future priorities.

item.title: Bexar County Poll Pad Anomalies Raise Questions in Texas Republican Primary; But Officials Push Back
item.description: Bexar County ghost voters totaling 4,110 impossible decimal-ID records appeared in San Antonio early voting data on February 18, 2026 then vanished overnight, according to Dr. Andrew Paquette’s analysis that every Texas voter needs to see.

item.title: Beyond Nukes: Iran’s Oil Lifeline to China Fuels U.S. Tensions
item.description: The Iran shadow fleet keeps delivering Iranian crude to China despite new US sanctions in February 2026, delivering tens of billions to Tehran and testing the limits of America’s maximum pressure strategy.

item.title: Feral Hogs Causing Billions in Damage — Austin County Bounty Program Continues [VIDEO]
item.description: Austin County’s Feral Hog Bounty Program offers $10 per hog harvested as officials work to reduce billions in agricultural and property damage caused by the growing feral hog population.

item.title: WWII Airman Returned Home to Beaumont After 80 Years
item.description: The remains of a Beaumont World War II airman have been returned home after 80 years and will be laid to rest with full military honors beside his parents.

item.title: Paid vs. Volunteer Fire Departments
item.description: An inside look at the key differences between paid fire departments and volunteer fire departments — and why fundraisers matter in rural communities like Austin County.

item.title: Traffic Stop Nets 20 Kilograms of Methamphetamine
item.description: A routine traffic stop on Interstate 10 in Austin County led to the seizure of 20 kilograms of methamphetamine hidden inside modified rope spools.

item.title: Austin County Cow-Calf Clinic – March 20
item.description: The Austin County Cow-Calf Clinic & Trade Show on March 20 will provide cattle producers with expert insight on herd health, reproduction, and livestock management at the Four County Auction Center in Bellville.

item.title: Geesaman Defeats Incumbent Kitzman in HD 85 Republican Primary
item.description: Texas HD 85 primary results deliver a stunning upset as Dennis "Goose" Geesaman defeats incumbent Stan Kitzman with 57% in the GOP race, full vote breakdowns and what’s next for this key Texas district.
